english: It does stink.\fBut this [blue]Public Toilet[/color]\nis known for never opening.
One more thing.\fThe Shinsengumi\nare after the broker too.
Find him before them,\nor we're in trouble.
Want Gin Tama? Look here!\fThat's what it says.\nAn ad flyer.
Aaaah! That's bad!!\fLet's find that broker,\nquick!
This place was used\nfor shady deals, huh?
Our fault too,\nletting them use us.
Shinpachi, what did\nyou order your pals to do?
I've got the top-secret\nintel you ordered.
After the shady Gin Tama broker.
Then what about the deal\nat [blue]Kamakko Club[/color]?
The Joi want them.\fBetter investigate\nthe Gin Tama trade routes.
Fine, I'll tell you.\nKnow the [red]shady broker[/color]?
All I know about\nthe [red]shady broker[/color]\nis he's a Chatoran.
A match? No time\nto play with cats!
Don't know where\nthe [blue]Pond[/color] is.\nThat's all I can do.
That bastard?!\fSo you know\nwhere the [red]shady broker[/color] is!
Catch the [red]shady broker[/color]\nand get that Dragon Tama!
Hard to find, though.\nLook carefully\nand you'll reach the [blue]Pond[/color].
[blue]Forest Trail[/color]. Got it.\nDon't stay out too late.
I told you! Into\nthe [blue]Forest Trail[/color]!\f...Your mind's full\nof dirty stuff, isn't it?
Oh, found work yet?\fDon't give up.\nI'm rooting for you.

Our [blue]Recycle Shop[/color]
handles unwanted things... But unwanted people
aren't our business.
Sorry.
Wow! The famous [blue]Nabeya[/color]?!\nI'll come eat sometime.\nGive me a discount!
Anything, if it comes\nwith meals, naps\nand endless paid leave!
An errand for [blue]Nabeya[/color]...?\nWhat was it...\nRamen and rice...
Had lunch at [blue]Denii's[/color],\nthey say...\nMight still be there.
I know! Straight to [blue]Nabeya[/color]!\nKeep yelling like that\nand you'll go bald.
Look, the moon's\nso beautiful...\nYou get those moods, right?
Don't look at us like that\njust because we're thieves!
Why not come work here? Such a waste...
Running low on Gin Tama from all those battles? Take these.
Don't tell Mama I gave you Gin Tama...
Knowing that idiot, he's drunk somewhere nearby.
I see... Come back when you're hungry.
Please enjoy yourself at a free table.
Tell me right away if anything happens.
